name: Soham Ratnaparkhi
title: Product Lead at HydraDB · databases, backends, infrastructure

paragraphs: I like building databases and the backends around them. I lead product at HydraDB, where I started as the founding engineer.
Outside work I read the classic systems papers and write about what I learn on my blog.

I like building databases and the backends around them: storage, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps them up. I lead product at HydraDB, where I started as the founding engineer and built the platform from zero.
Outside work I read the classic systems papers and write about what I learn on my blog.
